title: Link allocation amount to monthly budget savings
changes: Optional one-way link from budget.savings to the standalone savings allocation window
Linked allocations use the live monthly budget savings value and automatically recalculate currency amounts
Manual allocation amount and monthly/one-time mode are preserved while linked and restored when unlinked
Linked mode disables manual amount and period inputs, adds an explanatory status label, and persists preference in the existing allocation-only browser key
Budget save events trigger refresh on the open allocation dialog without modifying budget values or the financial calculators
Added regression tests for legacy allocations, link changes and zero savings
